message.content:
This magazine cover, titled "TEMPO" in large gray letters, features a white background with a vertical red band on the left edge. Below the title, the phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" appears in small, spaced-out gray text. At the top right, a small black-and-white portrait of a man with glasses is visible next to the text "ANIES BASWEDAN: MAKIN DIKRITIK, MAKIN NAIK".

The central focus consists of five black-and-white photographs of young children. These children appear extremely thin, with visible ribs and sunken facial features. They wear simple shorts or diapers. In the top-left photo, a child lies with arms outstretched. In the top-right, a child sits hunched over. The bottom row shows three children standing or lying against a dark, textured background.

Centered between the top photos is the red and black text: "INVESTIGASI KIAMAT DI ASMAT". Below this, smaller black text reads: "RATUSAN ANAK DI ASMAT, PAPUA, TERSERANG CAMPAK DAN GIZI BURUK, 72 MENINGGAL. AKIBAT SALAH URUS DAN DUGAAN KORUPSI." The The bottom right corner contains a barcode, the date "12-18 FEBRUARI 2018", price "RP 45.000", and a website address.
